_doc: Template for a K (knowledge the model cannot have) spec. Copy to northstar/specs/<task>/K.json (a task kept outside the repo, such as a reserve task, keeps it at <task dir>/specs/K.json, with its probes in <task dir>/specs/probes/ and grader-side overlays in <task dir>/ref-ep/) and replace every example. Each fact is ONE piece of knowledge that reached the build only through the owner: a standing rule from an earlier session, a private domain fact, a founder pricing rule. Each fact carries one deterministic check against the built artifact. The score is passed facts / all facts, so write 6 to 10 facts that each fail when the knowledge is missing and pass when it is applied. Do not repeat the task's stated behaviour (that is H): probe the private rule at boundaries and on inputs the stated examples do not cover. A missing module, export or server fails its fact. Keep machine paths and personal data out of the spec.
_doc_vars: Optional named numbers for arguments. An argument written {"$": "t0 - 6*H"} is evaluated as plain arithmetic over these vars (digits, vars, + - * / and parentheses only).
_doc_server: Needed only by http facts. cmd runs in the build directory with PORT set; a path starting with @spec/ resolves inside this spec's directory (for a launcher that wires up the build's modules).

facts.rule: One sentence: the private rule this fact tests, in the owner's words.
facts._doc: call: import the module (path relative to the build), call the export with args (awaited), compare. expect keys, all must hold: equals, not_equals, oneOf [..], integer true, gte, lte, matches "regex" (on String(value)), subset {..} (the result contains these fields), throws true or "message text" (the call must throw).

facts.rule: A private domain fact visible through the running product.
facts._doc: http: needs spec.server. expect.json is a subset match on the parsed body. Remove keys you do not need.

facts.rule: A multi-step rule that needs setup (sequence of calls, state, a clock).
facts._doc: script: node runs <spec dir>/probes/example.mjs (the spec dir is northstar/specs/<task>/ in the repo, <task dir>/specs/ outside it) with the build directory as cwd and GRADE_BUILD_DIR and GRADE_ARGS in the environment. The probe MUST import { dir, load, pass, fail } from the grader's sk-probe.mjs using the location-independent specifier "@graders/sk-probe.mjs" (the grader runs probes with a resolve hook that maps @graders/<file> to the graders directory, so it works for in-repo and external tasks alike; other helpers import the same way, e.g. "@graders/sk-browser.mjs"; relative paths to the graders break outside the repo) and finish by calling pass("what was verified"); call fail("why") on a failed assertion. Only pass() completes a probe: the grader requires exit 0 AND the run's completion record, so a script that merely ends, or a build that calls process.exit(0) while loading, does not pass. Load build modules with await load("src/x.mjs").

facts.rule: A standing rule that is only visible in the code (use sparingly; prefer call/http/script).
facts._doc_depends_on: Any fact may list ids of earlier facts in depends_on; it is credited only if they passed (use it so a check that finds nothing in an empty build cannot pass).
facts._doc: source: the regexes in requires must all match, none of forbids may match, across the listed files or directories (tests and docs are excluded).
